tutorial-content-desc-boss: The final boss group. Defeat it to complete this dungeon.
tutorial-content-desc-core-repair: Restores the shared Core HP for this dungeon. It does not restore hero HP.
tutorial-content-desc-cache: Appears in boss rooms. Walk onto it to extract the Cache signal; this consumes Neural Sync.
tutorial-content-desc-enemy: Walk onto an enemy-group tile to start one Tower Defense operation. Every enemy in that group appears in the battle.
tutorial-content-desc-lore: Discover background lore about the world.
tutorial-content-desc-quest: A signal marker for an upcoming objective. It currently provides information only.
tutorial-content-desc-trap-shrine: Looks exactly like a Loot Crate, but damages the dungeon Core HP instead of giving rewards.
tutorial-content-tiles-ambiguity-note: Loot and Trap Shrine tiles look identical (⬢, same color). You cannot tell them apart!
tutorial-death-protection-toast: {{heroName}} took lethal damage but will keep fighting for you.
tutorial-door-desc-locked: Doors lock while the room still has undefeated enemies. Clear the room first.
tutorial-door-desc-open: The arrow points toward the adjacent room.
tutorial-dungeon-create-wayfinding: Not here yet? Open City Mode first, then come back to create the tutorial dungeon.
tutorial-dungeon-nav-city-mode-body: Your squad is assembled. Open City Mode from the terminal home screen to head out.
tutorial-dungeon-nav-city-spot-body: Pick Terminal Ark Lower Deck Outskirts — the closest district, and where your first dungeon is.
tutorial-dungeon-nav-city-area-body: Enter the Abandoned Carnival Bar. This is the area your tutorial dungeon runs in.
tutorial-dungeon-nav-dungeon-button-body: Tap Dungeon to open the dungeon actions for this area.
tutorial-dungeon-desc: A specially designed dungeon for new players. Enemies are very weak — perfect for learning the basics.
tutorial-dungeon-action-bar-body: This bar shows the shared Core HP and how many combat rooms remain. Core HP belongs to the dungeon, not one hero.
tutorial-dungeon-legend-body: Open the Legend to identify doors, rooms, enemies, and special content tiles before you move.
tutorial-dungeon-door-to-battle-body: The highlighted door leads to the first battle room. Walk your marker through it to continue.
tutorial-dungeon-door-to-core-repair-bod: After clearing the battle, follow the highlighted door to the Core Repair room.
tutorial-dungeon-room-basics-body: This is the current room. Move through open doors to explore; locked doors open after the room's enemies are cleared.
tutorial-dungeon-enemy-tile-body: The enemy-group tile starts a Tower Defense operation when you walk onto it. Clear every enemy group in the room before its doors unlock.
tutorial-dungeon-encounter-intel-body: Open Enemy intel to see every hostile that will appear in this operation.
tutorial-dungeon-encounter-monitor-body: Open Monitor to inspect the enemy route, entry points, and Core before committing your team.
tutorial-dungeon-encounter-operation-bod: You have checked the field and enemy group. Select Operation to enter the defense.
tutorial-dungeon-after-battle-body: After the battle, move through the open door to continue to the next room.
tutorial-dungeon-core-hp-body: Core HP belongs to the whole dungeon and is separate from each hero's HP. If Core HP reaches zero, the run fails.
tutorial-dungeon-core-repair-body: Walk onto Core Repair to restore the shared Core HP. It repairs the core, not your heroes.
tutorial-dungeon-boss-body: This is the Boss tile. Defeat the boss to finish the tutorial dungeon.
tutorial-dungeon-tips-items: Use items from your inventory to restore HP or AP during exploration.
tutorial-dungeon-tips-map: Click the minimap in the top-right corner to open the full dungeon map.
tutorial-dungeon-tips-share: Public dungeons support up to 3 players.
tutorial-map-node-desc-unvisited: A room you haven't reached yet.
tutorial-map-node-desc-visited: A room you've already been to.
tutorial-onboarding-claim-all-body: Tap here to claim everything at once.
tutorial-onboarding-claim-row-body: This is your starter pack — tap it to see what's inside.
tutorial-onboarding-open-apps-menu-body: Tap the app menu icon in the corner to open your apps.
tutorial-onboarding-open-inbox-body: Open your Inbox — your starter pack is waiting there.
tutorial-room-desc-battle: Face enemies in turn-based card combat.
tutorial-room-desc-boss: The final boss. Defeat it to complete the dungeon.
tutorial-room-desc-elite-reward: Exchange more Reward Tokens for higher-tier items.
tutorial-room-desc-lore: Discover background lore about the world of Terminal Ark.
tutorial-room-desc-start: The entry point of the dungeon. Begin your exploration here.
tutorial-room-desc-trap: Opening a reward node may reveal a trap box. Be prepared!
tutorial-skip-confirm-line-1: To help you understand the game better, skipping the tutorial is not recommended.
tutorial-skip-confirm-line-2: Once skipped, this guide cannot be opened again.
tutorial-step-16-body: Well done! Tap "Leave Dungeon" to exit, then confirm in the dialog.
tutorial-step-5-body: Choose the Tutorial Dungeon from the list and create a new instance.
tutorial-step-8a-body: This is the room view — walls, doors, and tiles on the floor (terrain and content tiles). Walk onto a content tile to trigger its effect.
tutorial-step-8b-body: The minimap in the top-right shows nearby rooms. Click it to open the full map.
tutorial-step-8c-body: This section shows your heroes' current HP and status.
tutorial-step-8d-body: The action bar shows your AP (graphical bar) and reward tokens. Use "Leave" to exit the dungeon.
tutorial-terrain-desc-contaminated: Independent chance to loot elite-grade salvage and damage the dungeon Core HP (never reduces it below 1). One-time trigger.
tutorial-terrain-desc-speed: Speeds up movement when walked over.
tutorial-terrain-desc-trap: Deals 1% of the dungeon Core HP max (never reduces it below 1).
tutorial-training-action-locked: Follow the highlighted training step first.
tutorial-training-target-pending: Still locating the target on screen — hold on a moment.
tutorial-training-wrong-tile: Not that tile. Drop the hero on the highlighted square.
tutorial-training-wrong-hero: Not that hero yet — deploy the one the guide is asking for.
tutorial-training-hud-core: Core HP is the health of your base. If it reaches 0, the defense fails.
tutorial-training-hud-bandwidth: Bandwidth is your deployment budget. Each hero on the field consumes part of it.
tutorial-training-hud-deploy-limit: This counter shows how many heroes are deployed and the maximum allowed in this battle.
tutorial-training-hud-wave: Wave shows the current enemy wave. Clear every wave to finish the defense.
tutorial-training-hud-next-wave: The countdown shows when the next enemy wave will arrive.
tutorial-training-hud-kills: Kills counts enemies defeated in this battle.
tutorial-training-hud-speed: Use the speed controls to pause or change simulation speed. Training will guide you when to resume.
tutorial-training-deploy-panel: The bottom roster contains your starter heroes. Drag a hero onto a highlighted tile to deploy it; the card also shows its cost and cooldown.
tutorial-training-hero-bars: Every hero has two bars below them. The upper yellow bar is the Charge bar; it turns magenta when full and the skill is ready. The lower red bar is the HP bar.
tutorial-training-select-hero: Now click Krohn on the battlefield. Selecting a hero opens its field HUD.
tutorial-training-hero-hud: This is the selected hero's HUD. It shows the hero's actions and skill controls.
tutorial-training-hero-charge: The skill control shows the same Charge state. Wait for Krohn's bar to fill; the skill button will become available.
tutorial-training-aim-body: Drag toward the top of the map, where the enemies come from, then release to lock it in.
tutorial-training-aim-hint: Now aim him — press that tile again and hold.
tutorial-training-aim-omnidirectional: She heals in every direction, so it doesn’t matter which way she faces — drag any direction and release to lock it in.
tutorial-training-cast-krohn-skill: Krohn is fully charged. Press Dual Slaughter to empower his next basic attack.
tutorial-training-clear-waves: The lane is live. Hold the core through both waves.
tutorial-training-deploy-grell-body: Drop him on the highlighted ground tile to block the lane.
tutorial-training-deploy-grell-hint: Drag Grell from the roster below onto the battlefield.
tutorial-training-deploy-kaiya-body: Drop her on the highlighted elevated tile to heal Grell.
tutorial-training-deploy-kaiya-hint: Drag Kaiya from the roster below onto the battlefield.
tutorial-training-deploy-krohn-body: Place Krohn left of the enemy tile blocked in front of Grell, then aim right.
tutorial-training-deploy-krohn-hint: Drag Krohn from the roster below onto the battlefield.
tutorial-training-entry-body: Your first tower-defense simulation is ready in the Training app.
tutorial-training-face-up-retry: Aim this melee hero toward the marked lane, then try again.
tutorial-training-free-practice-body: Run the fixed two-wave simulation freely. This mode does not change progress or grant rewards.
tutorial-training-reset-hint: Clear tutorial progress and start the guided simulation again.
tutorial-training-aim-krohn-body: Aim Krohn right, toward Grell's blocked lane, then release to confirm.
tutorial-wasteland-build-power-body: Finally, open the next activity slot and build a Nuclear Power Plant in the panel. Other facilities need enough power to run steadily.
tutorial-wasteland-build-power-tip: A Nuclear Power Plant supplies baseline power without an assigned agent, making it one of the most important early facilities.
tutorial-wasteland-contextual-build-body: Tap this buildable slot to open the build panel. Choose a facility there to construct it. Building costs building points.
tutorial-wasteland-map-body: This is the Wasteland depth signal map. Facilities are laid out by depth—tap any slot to open a panel and build or inspect it.
tutorial-wasteland-nav-terminal-tab-body: Good work down there. Tap the Terminal tab to head back to your home screen.
tutorial-wasteland-nav-agent-workstation: Open the Wasteland Development Terminal — this is where your facilities keep producing while you are away.
tutorial-wasteland-modify-mode-body: Open modification mode first. It shows your building points and lets you construct facilities in available slots.
tutorial-wasteland-review-power-body: Open the power indicator at the top. It shows current supply and load, including the capacity provided by your new Nuclear Power Plant.
tutorial-wasteland-power-confirm-body: Power capacity keeps facilities online. Review these live values, then continue when you are ready to explore Terminal Ark freely.
tutorial-complete-welcome-body: Your terminal is ready. You now have the essentials to operate, explore, and expand.
tutorial-complete-next-body: Explore the city and its dungeons, manage your squad, and keep developing Wasteland facilities from the terminal.
tutorial-complete-signal-body: Your beginner pack included 20 Common Decoders. Use them in the Signal Hijack System's Standard Channel for two 10-draw attempts.
tutorial-complete-error: The tutorial status could not be saved. Please try again.
tutorial-welcome-workstation-hint: Manage your base from the Wasteland Terminal
tutorial-welcome-workstation-hint-sub: Build facilities, assign agents, generate resources
tutorial-workstation-manufacturing-stati: Manufacturing Station: process raw materials into usable items.
tutorial-workstation-power-plant-body: Power Plant: generate the energy your facilities need.
tutorial-workstation-rest-room-body: Rest Room: agents recover stamina here.
tutorial-workstation-super-terminal-body: Super Terminal: the heart of your base. Upgrading it unlocks more facilities.
tutorial-workstation-trading-station-bod: Trading Station: trade resources with other players.
